```{r}
# load the image
load('processed_data/aggregating.rda')
qc_dt <- fread("processed_data/qc_summary.csv")
gene_quants <- readRDS("suppa_analysis/gene_expressions.rds")
download_metadata <- fread("processed_data/file_table.csv.gz")
fig1_color_dt <- unique(metadata[, .(harmonized_sample_ontology_term_high_order_fig1, harmonized_sample_ontology_term_high_order_fig1_color)])
color_mapping <- setNames(fig1_color_dt$harmonized_sample_ontology_term_high_order_fig1_color, fig1_color_dt$harmonized_sample_ontology_term_high_order_fig1)
color_mapping_hex <- sapply(strsplit(color_mapping, ","), function(x) rgb(x[1], x[2], x[3], maxColorValue=255))
```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=10}
metadata_order <- melt(metadata, id.vars=c("EpiRR_ordering", "epirr_id_without_version"), measure.vars = c("automated_experiments_RNA-Seq_mRNA-Seq", "automated_experiments_RNA-Seq_total-RNA-Seq"), variable.name = "experiment_type", value.name = "uuid")[uuid != ""][order(EpiRR_ordering, uuid)]
metadata_order[, experiment_type := tstrsplit(experiment_type, "_", keep = 4)]
gene_mat <- as.matrix(dcast(gene_quants, uuid ~ gene_id), 
                       rownames = 'uuid')[metadata_order[, uuid], ]
gene_pca <- rsvd::rpca(gene_mat, 4)
rsvd::ggscreeplot(gene_pca)
variance = gene_pca$sdev^2
explained_variance_ratio = round(variance/gene_pca$var, 3) * 100
plot_dt <- as.data.table(gene_pca$x, keep.rownames = "uuid")
setnames(plot_dt, c("V1", "V2"), c("PC1", "PC2"))
plot_dt[download_metadata[assay_type == "RNA-Seq"], on=.NATURAL, c("experiment_type", "epirr_id_without_version"):=.(experiment_type, epirr_id_without_version)]
plot_dt[qc_dt, on=.NATURAL, c("fraction_mapped", "fraction_intergenic", "fraction_rrna", "fraction_duplicates") := .(fraction_mapped, fraction_intergenic, fraction_rrna, fraction_duplicates)]
plot_dt <- merge(plot_dt, metadata)
setorder(plot_dt, EpiRR_ordering, uuid)
stopifnot(rownames(gene_pca$x) == plot_dt$uuid)
ggplot(plot_dt, aes(x=PC1, y=PC2, color=fraction_mapped)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "PCA of gene expression data", 
       x = paste("PC1 (", explained_variance_ratio[1], "% explained var.)", sep = ""),
       y = paste("PC2 (", explained_variance_ratio[2], "% explained var.)", sep = ""))
ggplot(plot_dt, aes(x=PC1, y=PC2, color=fraction_intergenic)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "PCA of gene expression data", 
       x = paste("PC1 (", explained_variance_ratio[1], "% explained var.)", sep = ""),
       y = paste("PC2 (", explained_variance_ratio[2], "% explained var.)", sep = ""))
ggplot(plot_dt, aes(x=PC1, y=PC2, color=fraction_rrna)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "PCA of gene expression data", 
       x = paste("PC1 (", explained_variance_ratio[1], "% explained var.)", sep = ""),
       y = paste("PC2 (", explained_variance_ratio[2], "% explained var.)", sep = ""))
ggplot(plot_dt, aes(x=PC1, y=PC2, color=fraction_duplicates)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "PCA of gene expression data", 
       x = paste("PC1 (", explained_variance_ratio[1], "% explained var.)", sep = ""),
       y = paste("PC2 (", explained_variance_ratio[2], "% explained var.)", sep = ""))
rsvd::ggindplot(gene_pca, groups = plot_dt[, experiment_type], ind_labels = FALSE)
rsvd::ggindplot(gene_pca, pcs = c(1,3), groups = plot_dt[, experiment_type], ind_labels = FALSE)
onto_plot <- rsvd::ggindplot(gene_pca, groups = plot_dt[, factor(harmonized_sample_ontology_term_high_order_fig1, levels=unique(harmonized_sample_ontology_term_high_order_fig1))], ind_labels = FALSE, alpha.ellipse = 0) + scale_color_manual(values = color_mapping_hex)
onto_plot[["guides"]][["colour"]] <- NULL
onto_plot
```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=10}
# Now do this first on RI and then on SE events
for (this_event in to_analyze){
  # and with and without the filtered events
  curr_dt <- event_dt[`Event Type` == this_event]
  for (this_filter in list(curr_dt[, ID], keep_rows)){
    # filter the data
    filtered_dt <- curr_dt[ID %in% this_filter]
    for (this_experiment_type in list(c("total-RNA-Seq", "mRNA-Seq"), c("total-RNA-Seq"), c("mRNA-Seq"))) {
      integration <- c("original")
      # impute all NA's by colmean
      if (length(this_experiment_type) == 2) {
        integration <- c("original")#, "integrated")
      }
      for (this_integration in integration){
        warning("Processing ", this_event, " events, ", ifelse(identical(this_filter, curr_dt[, ID]), "all", "filtered"), " events, ", paste(this_experiment_type, collapse = " & "), " samples, ", this_integration, " data", sep = "")
        this_sample_cols <- download_metadata[experiment_type %in% this_experiment_type, uuid]
        event_mat <- as.matrix(dcast(melt(filtered_dt, id.vars = "ID", measure.vars = this_sample_cols, na.rm = TRUE), variable ~ ID), rownames = TRUE)[metadata_order[uuid %in% this_sample_cols, uuid], ]
        if (this_integration == "integrated") {
          # integrate the data
          stopifnot(metadata_order[, uuid] == rownames(event_mat))
          ## --- helpers
          clip  <- function(p, eps=1e-4) pmin(pmax(p, eps), 1-eps)
          logit <- function(p) qlogis(clip(p))
          ilogit<- function(z) plogis(z)
          
          ## --- identify valid anchors: exactly 2 rows per epirr, one per assay
          pairs_dt <- metadata_order[, if(.SD[, length(uuid) > 1]) .SD, by=epirr_id_without_version]
          batch <- factor(metadata_order$experiment_type)
          
          ## --- transform: logit(PSI)
          Y_raw <- apply(event_mat, 2, logit)  # samples x events; NAs preserved
          
          ## --- keep events with enough observations in BOTH assays (reduces NA impute bias)
          min_per_batch <- 10
          keep_ev <- vapply(seq_len(ncol(Y_raw)), function(j){
            tab <- tapply(!is.na(Y_raw[, j]), batch, sum)
            all(!is.na(tab)) && all(tab >= min_per_batch)
          }, logical(1))
          Y <- Y_raw[, keep_ev, drop=FALSE]
          
          ## --- impute remaining NAs WITHIN assay (ComBat cannot handle NA)
          impute_within_batch <- function(mat, batch){
            out <- mat
            for(b in levels(batch)){
              idx <- which(batch == b)
              mu  <- colMeans(out[idx, , drop=FALSE], na.rm=TRUE)
              miss <- is.na(out[idx, , drop=FALSE])
              if(any(miss)) out[idx, ][miss] <- rep(mu, each=length(idx))[miss]
            }
            out
          }
          Y_imp <- impute_within_batch(Y, batch)
          
          subj_factor <- factor(ifelse(metadata_order$uuid %in% pairs_dt[, uuid], metadata_order$epirr_id_without_version, NA))
          Y_adj <- removeBatchEffect(
            Y_imp, batch = factor(meta$experiment_type), design = model.matrix(~ 0 + subj_factor)
          )
          
          # 5) (optional) back to PSI for visualization / PCA
          event_mat_adj <- apply(Y_adj, 2, ilogit)
          
        }
        for (i in 1:ncol(event_mat)){
          event_mat[is.na(event_mat[,i]), i] <- mean(event_mat[,i], na.rm = TRUE)
        }
        event_pca <- rsvd::rpca(event_mat, 4)
        rsvd::ggscreeplot(event_pca)
        variance = event_pca$sdev^2
        explained_variance_ratio = round(variance/event_pca$var, 3) * 100
        plot_dt <- as.data.table(event_pca$x, keep.rownames = "uuid")
        setnames(plot_dt, c("V1", "V2"), c("PC1", "PC2"))
        plot_dt[download_metadata[assay_type == "RNA-Seq"], on=.NATURAL, c("experiment_type", "epirr_id_without_version"):=.(experiment_type, epirr_id_without_version)]
        plot_dt[qc_dt, on=.NATURAL, c("fraction_mapped", "fraction_intergenic", "fraction_rrna", "fraction_duplicates") := .(fraction_mapped, fraction_intergenic, fraction_rrna, fraction_duplicates)]
        plot_dt <- merge(plot_dt, metadata)
        setorder(plot_dt, EpiRR_ordering, uuid)
        stopifnot(rownames(event_pca$x) == plot_dt$uuid)
        title_string <- paste("PCA of", this_event, "events; filtered", identical(this_filter == keep_rows), "; experiment_type:", paste(this_experiment_type, collapse = " and "))
        print(ggplot(plot_dt, aes(x=PC1, y=PC2, color=fraction_mapped)) +
          geom_point() +
          labs(title = title_string, 
               x = paste("PC1 (", explained_variance_ratio[1], "% explained var.)", sep = ""),
               y = paste("PC2 (", explained_variance_ratio[2], "% explained var.)", sep = "")))
        print(ggplot(plot_dt, aes(x=PC1, y=PC2, color=fraction_intergenic)) +
          geom_point() +
          labs(title = title_string, 
               x = paste("PC1 (", explained_variance_ratio[1], "% explained var.)", sep = ""),
               y = paste("PC2 (", explained_variance_ratio[2], "% explained var.)", sep = "")))
        print(ggplot(plot_dt, aes(x=PC1, y=PC2, color=fraction_rrna)) +
          geom_point() +
          labs(title = title_string, 
               x = paste("PC1 (", explained_variance_ratio[1], "% explained var.)", sep = ""),
               y = paste("PC2 (", explained_variance_ratio[2], "% explained var.)", sep = "")))
        print(ggplot(plot_dt, aes(x=PC1, y=PC2, color=fraction_duplicates)) +
          geom_point() +
          labs(title = title_string, 
               x = paste("PC1 (", explained_variance_ratio[1], "% explained var.)", sep = ""),
               y = paste("PC2 (", explained_variance_ratio[2], "% explained var.)", sep = "")))
        print(rsvd::ggindplot(event_pca, groups = plot_dt[, experiment_type], ind_labels = FALSE))
        print(rsvd::ggindplot(event_pca, pcs = c(1,3), groups = plot_dt[, experiment_type], ind_labels = FALSE))
        onto_plot <- rsvd::ggindplot(event_pca, groups = plot_dt[, factor(harmonized_sample_ontology_term_high_order_fig1, levels=unique(harmonized_sample_ontology_term_high_order_fig1))], ind_labels = FALSE, alpha.ellipse = 0) + scale_color_manual(values = color_mapping_hex)
        onto_plot[["guides"]][["colour"]] <- NULL
        print(onto_plot)
      }
    }
  }
}
```

# TODO variability or clustering:

```{r, compute-variability, eval=FALSE}
# compute Adj SD per event
event_dt[, `Adjusted PSI SD` := sqrt(rowSums((.SD - rowMeans(.SD, na.rm = TRUE))^2, na.rm = TRUE)/(length(sample_cols) - 1)), .SDcols = sample_cols]
# compute median Adj SD per event type on IDs in keep_rows
median_adj_sd <- event_dt[ID %in% keep_rows, .(med=median(`Adjusted PSI SD`, na.rm = TRUE), tmp_event_type=`Event Type`), by=`Event Type`][, `Event Type`:=NULL]
# assign variability to each event
event_dt[ID %in% keep_rows, Variability := ifelse(`Adjusted PSI SD`>=median_adj_sd[`Event Type` == tmp_event_type, med], 'High Variability', 'Low Variability'), by=`Event Type`]
event_dt[ID %in% manual_ids, Variability := ifelse(`Adjusted PSI SD`>=median_adj_sd[`Event Type` == tmp_event_type, med], 'High Variability', 'Low Variability'), by=`Event Type`]
# make sure the order is correct
event_dt[, Variability := factor(Variability, levels=c('Low Variability', 'High Variability'))]
```
